_about: Copy this to local.json (gitignored) to personalise the skill. Everything here is optional. Objects merge over verification.json key by key; a null DELETES that key, which is how you retire a `confirm_by` once you have answered it.

tracker._about: Present means the skill also syncs the report into this document, following the guide named below. Remove this whole block if you just want the report.
tracker.title: My Pokémon Playthrough Tracker

checked_against_save._about: The save you last verified the report against.
checked_against_save.note: Where you were in the game, and what you checked.

sections._about: Promote a section to confirmed once you have checked it in game. See references/verification.md.

items.how: Compared every pocket against the bag in game on the date above.

save_history._about: Only if your save has a history that makes the report look odd — imported Pokémon, a save editor, a mid-playthrough ROM change.

overrides._about: Escape hatches for a ROM newer than the source checkout. Prefer re-running tools/generate_tables.py.
